工作人员告诉我们，这些东西大部分是在附近的农村发现的。
The staff member told us that most of these objects had been found in the nearby countryside.
看着这些美丽的作品，我深深地感受到了古代人的智慧和想象力。

In addition, the museum had also set up an interactive area.
观众可以通过屏幕亲自体验古代人做手工的过程，孩子们都玩得特别开心。
Visitors could use screens to experience for themselves how ancient people made handicrafts, and the children had a great time.
离开的时候，我买了几张明信片作为纪念。
When we left, I bought a few postcards as souvenirs.
这次参观让我明白，博物馆并不是一个无聊的地方，而是了解历史的一扇窗户。
This visit made me realize that a museum is not a boring place, but a window for understanding history.
小时候，我一直梦想能弹钢琴，可是家里条件有限，这个愿望始终没有实现。

去年我四十岁生日的时候，丈夫送给我一架二手钢琴，还帮我报了一个成人钢琴班。
Last year, on my fortieth birthday, my husband gave me a secondhand piano and also signed me up for an adult piano class.

At the first lesson, I found that my classmates were all about my age, including a retired teacher and a company manager.
大家虽然基础不同，但是都对音乐充满了热情。
Although everyone had a different foundation, we were all full of enthusiasm for music.
老师说，成年人学乐器有自己的优势，因为我们理解能力强，也更懂得自觉安排时间。
The teacher said adults have their own advantages in learning an instrument, because we understand things quickly and know better how to manage our time on our own.
当然，学习的过程并不轻松。
Of course, the learning process isn't easy.
我的手指很僵硬，一首简单的曲子要练好几个星期才能弹得流利。
My fingers are stiff, and I have to practice a simple piece for several weeks before I can play it fluently.
但是每当我坐在钢琴前，听到美妙的旋律，所有的烦恼好像都消失了。
But whenever I sit at the piano and hear a beautiful melody, all my worries seem to disappear.
现在，我已经能完整地弹几首自己喜欢的歌了。
Now I can already play several songs I like all the way through.
我相信，学习永远不会太迟，关键在于坚持。
I believe it is never too late to learn; the key is to keep at it.
我们小区门口有一家小小的水果店，老板是一位五十多岁的阿姨。
At the entrance to our neighborhood there is a small fruit shop, and the owner is a woman in her fifties.
她每天早上五点就去批发市场进货，挑选最新鲜的水果。
Every morning at five she goes to the wholesale market to stock up and pick out the freshest fruit.
她的店面虽然不大，但是收拾得干干净净，水果摆得整整齐齐。
Her shop isn't big, but it is kept spotless, and the fruit is laid out neatly.
She runs her business with great honesty.
如果水果有一点坏，她会主动告诉顾客，或者便宜一些卖。
If a piece of fruit is a little bad, she tells the customer on her own or sells it cheaper.
遇到老人买东西，她常常亲自把水果送到家里。
When elderly people buy from her, she often delivers the fruit to their homes herself.
时间长了，附近的居民都愿意来她这儿买，生意也越来越好。
Over time, the residents nearby all like to come to her, and business keeps getting better.
前几年，网上购物发展得很快，不少小店因为竞争激烈而倒闭了。
A few years ago online shopping grew quickly, and many small shops closed down because of fierce competition.
阿姨也遇到了不小的压力。
不过，她没有抱怨，而是让女儿教她用手机接受订单，并提供送货服务。
However, she didn't complain; instead she had her daughter teach her to take orders on her phone, and she began offering delivery.
现在，她的店不但没有关门，反而多了很多年轻的顾客。
Now her shop has not only stayed open but has gained many young customers.
她常说，做生意和做人一样，只有真心对待别人，才能赢得别人的信任。
She often says that doing business is like being a person: only by treating others sincerely can you win their trust.
近年来，人工智能迅速普及到各个行业，给职场带来了巨大的冲击。
In recent years, artificial intelligence has rapidly spread across every industry, bringing a huge shock to the workplace.
许多重复、单调的工作已经由软件承担，效率显著提高。
Many repetitive, monotonous tasks are already handled by software, and efficiency has risen markedly.
然而，不少员工对此感到焦虑，担心自己的岗位会被取代。
However, quite a few employees feel anxious about this, worried that their positions will be taken over.
事实上，技术淘汰的往往是某些任务，而不是整个职业。
In fact, what technology eliminates is often certain tasks, not entire professions.
善于利用新工具的人，反而能够摆脱机械的劳动，把精力投入到更有创造性的环节。
People who are good at using new tools can instead escape mechanical labor and put their energy into more creative parts of the work.
比如，律师可以借助程序筛选资料，从而抽出时间思考案子的关键。
For example, a lawyer can use a program to sift through materials, freeing up time to think about the crux of a case.
不过，人工智能并不是无所不能的，它的判断有时会出现错误，甚至会凭空编出根本不存在的信息。
But artificial intelligence is not all-powerful: its judgments are sometimes wrong, and it may even invent information that does not exist at all.
因此，人类的监督和检验依然必不可少。
Therefore, human supervision and checking remain essential.
企业在引进新技术时，也应当重视员工的培训，而不是只顾着降低成本。
When companies bring in new technology, they should also value employee training instead of focusing only on cutting costs.
说到底，决定未来的不是机器本身，而是我们如何掌握它。
In the end, what decides the future is not the machines themselves but how we master them.
中国传统建筑以木结构为主，讲究与自然环境的和谐。
Traditional Chinese architecture is mainly built of wood and pays close attention to harmony with the natural environment.
古代的师傅在建造房屋时，很少使用金属，而是依靠巧妙的结构把各个部分连接在一起。
When master builders in ancient times put up houses, they seldom used metal, relying instead on clever joinery to connect the parts.
这种结构不仅坚固，而且富有弹性，在地震中往往能够减轻巨大的冲击。
This structure is not only sturdy but also flexible, and in earthquakes it can often soften enormous shocks.
屋顶的形状也很有讲究，四角向上弯起，既能排出雨水，又显得轻巧优美。
The shape of the roof is also carefully considered: its four corners curve upward, which both drains rainwater and looks light and graceful.
在安排上，传统住宅通常坐北朝南，以便冬天充分接受阳光。
In layout, traditional homes usually sit facing south, so they get plenty of sunlight in winter.
四合院就是一个典型的例子，几代人围绕院子居住，体现了重视家庭团圆的观念。
The courtyard house is a typical example: several generations lived around one courtyard, reflecting a value placed on family togetherness.
遗憾的是，随着城市化的推进，大量老建筑被拆除，换成了样子相同的高楼。
Unfortunately, as urbanization advanced, large numbers of old buildings were torn down and replaced by identical high-rises.
近年来，越来越多的人意识到保护文化遗产的迫切性。
In recent years, more and more people have realized how urgent it is to protect cultural heritage.
一些地方开始修复古老的街区，并在保留原来面目的前提下改善居住条件。
Some places have begun restoring old neighborhoods, improving living conditions while keeping their original look.
这些建筑包含着祖先的智慧，值得我们用心珍惜。
These buildings hold the wisdom of our ancestors and deserve to be cherished with care.
人的一生大约有三分之一的时间是在睡眠中度过的。
Roughly a third of a person's life is spent asleep.
过去，人们普遍认为睡觉只是让身体休息，大脑也随之停止工作。
In the past, people generally believed that sleep merely rested the body and that the brain stopped working along with it.
然而，现代研究表明，睡眠时大脑依然相当活跃。
However, modern research shows that the brain remains quite active during sleep.
在深度睡眠阶段，大脑会清理白天积累的有害物质，并巩固新学到的知识。
In the deep sleep stage, the brain clears away harmful substances built up during the day and consolidates newly learned knowledge.
而在做梦较多的阶段，情绪记忆得到整理，这有助于我们调节心理状态。
In the stage with more dreaming, emotional memories are sorted, which helps us regulate our mental state.
长期睡眠不足的危害不能忽视，它会降低免疫力，导致注意力下降，甚至增加患病的风险。
The harm of long-term sleep deprivation cannot be ignored: it lowers immunity, weakens concentration, and even raises the risk of illness.
可是在快节奏的社会里，熬夜对许多年轻人来说已经是家常便饭。
Yet in a fast-paced society, staying up late has become an everyday thing for many young people.
睡前长时间看手机，屏幕发出的光线会抑制身体的自然节奏，使人难以入睡。
When people look at their phones for a long time before bed, the light from the screen disrupts the body's natural rhythm, making it hard to fall asleep.
专家建议，保持有规律的生活，避免在晚上摄入咖啡因，并为卧室创造安静、光线柔和的环境。
Experts advise keeping a regular routine, avoiding caffeine in the evening, and creating a quiet, softly lit environment in the bedroom.
与其事后弥补，不如从现在起把睡眠当作一项值得投资的健康习惯。
Rather than making up for it afterward, it is better to start now and treat sleep as a healthy habit worth investing in.
过去几十年里，大批农村青年涌入城市打工，许多村庄逐渐变得冷清。
Over the past few decades, large numbers of rural young people poured into cities to find work, and many villages gradually grew deserted.
留在家乡的大多是老人和孩子，田地没人种，传统技艺也面临消失的危机。
Those left behind in their hometowns were mostly the old and the young; fields went unfarmed, and traditional skills faced the danger of disappearing.
近年来，国家提出乡村振兴的目标，试图改变这一局面。
In recent years, the state has set the goal of rural revitalization, trying to change this situation.
各地根据自身条件，探索出了不同的发展道路。
Each region has explored its own path of development according to its own conditions.
有的村庄依靠优美的自然风光，发展乡村旅游，吸引城里人前来度假。
Some villages rely on their beautiful natural scenery to develop rural tourism, attracting city people to come on vacation.
有的村庄则借助网络直播，把当地的农产品销往全国各地。
Other villages use online livestreaming to sell local farm products all over the country.
与此同时，一部分在外打拼多年的年轻人选择回乡创业，带回了资金、技术和新的观念。
Meanwhile, some young people who had worked hard away from home for years chose to return and start businesses, bringing back capital, technology and new ideas.
当然，乡村的发展不是一朝一夕的事情。
Of course, developing the countryside does not happen overnight.
如果简单地模仿城市的模式，不仅会破坏原有的生态，还可能让村庄失去独特的魅力。
Simply imitating the urban model would not only damage the original ecology but might also cost villages their unique charm.
只有尊重当地的实际情况，让村民真正获得好处，乡村才能恢复持久的活力。
Only by respecting local realities and letting villagers truly benefit can the countryside regain lasting vitality.
广告是现代商业不可缺少的一部分，它帮助消费者了解产品，也推动了市场的繁荣。
Advertising is an indispensable part of modern commerce; it helps consumers learn about products and also drives market prosperity.
然而，并不是所有广告都遵守诚信的原则。
However, not all advertising follows the principle of honesty.
有些商家为了追求利润，故意夸张产品的效果，甚至隐藏可能带来的危害。
Some merchants, in pursuit of profit, deliberately exaggerate what their products can do and even hide the harm they may cause.
还有一些广告利用人们的焦虑心理，暗示不购买某种商品就会落后于他人。
Other ads exploit people's anxiety, implying that if you don't buy a certain product you will fall behind others.
这种做法虽然短期内能够刺激销量，却在不知不觉中损害了公众的信任。
Although this approach can boost sales in the short term, it quietly erodes public trust.
儿童尤其容易受到广告的影响，因为他们缺乏判断真假的能力。
Children are especially easily influenced by advertising, because they lack the ability to judge what is true and what is false.
因此，许多国家对面向儿童的广告制定了严格的规定。
For this reason, many countries have set strict rules for advertising aimed at children.
在网络时代，问题变得更加复杂。
In the internet age, the problem has become even more complicated.
平台通过收集用户的数据准确推送广告，这在一定程度上威胁到了个人隐私。
Platforms collect users' data to push precisely targeted ads, which to some extent threatens personal privacy.
作为消费者，我们应当保持理性，不要轻易被漂亮的宣传所欺骗。
As consumers, we should stay rational and not be easily fooled by attractive promotion.
而企业也应当明白，真正持久的品牌，是建立在诚实与责任之上的。
And companies should also understand that a truly lasting brand is built on honesty and responsibility.
人到中年，常常会忍不住怀念过去。
In middle age, people often can't help longing for the past.
一首老歌、一种熟悉的气味，都可能瞬间引起多年前的回忆。
An old song or a familiar smell can instantly bring back memories from many years ago.
心理学家发现，记忆并不像录像那样准确地保存过去的事，而是在每次回忆时被重新建立。
Psychologists have found that memory does not store past events accurately like a video recording; instead, it is rebuilt each time we recall it.
因此，我们记得的童年，往往比真实的童年更加美好。
So the childhood we remember is often better than the childhood we actually had.
那些艰苦的细节逐渐模糊，温暖的画面却被不断放大。
The hard details gradually blur, while the warm scenes keep being magnified.
这种怀念过去的情感曾经被视为一种消极的情绪，甚至被当作疾病来对待。
This longing for the past was once seen as a negative emotion and was even treated as an illness.
但近年来的研究表明，适度的怀念能够缓解孤独，增强人们对生活的意义感。
But research in recent years shows that a moderate amount of nostalgia can ease loneliness and strengthen people's sense of meaning in life.
当我们面临挫折时，想起曾经被关爱的时刻，内心会获得一种安慰和力量。
When we face setbacks, recalling moments when we were cared for gives us comfort and strength.
当然，如果总是停留在过去，拒绝接受眼前的变化，怀念就可能成为前进的障碍。
Of course, if we always linger in the past and refuse to accept the changes in front of us, nostalgia can become an obstacle to moving forward.
也许，最理想的态度是珍惜回忆，同时勇敢地面对未来。
Perhaps the ideal attitude is to cherish our memories while bravely facing the future.
